purpose.summary: Browser-based calculator app with standard, scientific, converter, financial, and grapher modes.

components.name: Calculator UI shell
components.purpose: Renders the calculator modes and manages state for expressions, history, and theme settings.

components.name: Expression evaluator
components.purpose: Parses and formats calculator expressions, percentages, factorials, and trigonometric operations.

components.name: Theme and styling system
components.purpose: Provides the calculator's visual language and theme presets.

entrypoints.name: React entrypoint
entrypoints.invocation: Vite mounts the app into the browser root

risks: Visual styling is distributed across CSS files and component classes, so visual changes require multiple edits.
No automated tests are defined in the package manifest.
The app stores user preferences and history locally in the browser, so state changes are not centrally managed.
unknowns: No product requirements or business workflow documentation exists in this repository.
No deployment or backend architecture is present because the app is client-side only.
